title: fix: reduce community monitor noise
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Wait 60 minutes between monitor cycles instead of 30
- Limit Discord output to two messages per cycle
- Combine same-cycle leaderboards and include root cause in the initial official-model alert
- Align healthcheck timing and operational documentation

gist.headline: Less buzzing, more signal
gist.blurb: The community monitor now takes a calmer lap around the garden and brings back only the useful bits. Fewer pings, tidier leaderboards, happier humans.
gist.summary: The community monitor now runs every 60 minutes instead of 30, caps Discord output at two messages per cycle, combines same-cycle leaderboards, and adds root-cause context to official-model alerts.
gist.impact: Community operators will receive fewer, more consolidated Discord updates while retaining clearer context when an official model alert appears.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a calm garden keeper with a tiny clipboard, tending a cozy notification garden where only two healthy message-flowers bloom from a retro terminal. A small clock set to 60 minutes, neatly bundled leaderboard scrolls, and a labeled root-cause plant convey slower monitor cycles, consolidated updates, and clearer alerts.
